Delivery areas

We deliver hot water systems, parts and accessories across New South Wales and to selected areas throughout Australia. Availability can vary with your postcode and the size of the product, so contact us first if you are outside the standard delivery area.

Delivery timeframes

Estimates only, and they can be affected by courier delays, weather or other events outside our control.

  • Regional NSW: 2 to 7 business days
  • Interstate: 3 to 10 business days

Delivery charges

Shipping is calculated at checkout from your delivery location, the size and weight of the product, and any installation requirements. Some products and promotional offers include free delivery within selected metro areas.

Installation deliveries

Where installation is booked with your purchase, our team contacts you to arrange a date and time once the order is confirmed. Scheduling depends on technician availability and your location.

On arrival

Please inspect your order when it arrives. If it looks damaged, incomplete or incorrect, tell us within 48 hours and include photographs where you can.

Returns

We comply with the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing here limits your rights under the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth).

Change of mind returns may be accepted at our discretion when the request is made within 30 days of delivery, the product has not been installed or used, it remains unopened in its original packaging and it is in resalable condition. Return shipping for approved change of mind returns is generally the customer's responsibility. Special order and custom products cannot be returned for change of mind.

If a product is faulty, damaged or not as described, contact us as soon as you can. Depending on the circumstances we may repair it, replace it, provide a refund or arrange collection. If you receive the wrong product, contact us within 48 hours and we will arrange a replacement or collection at no extra cost where the error is ours.

How to request a return

Contact our team with your order details, explain the reason, send photographs if we ask for them, and wait for return instructions before sending anything back. Returns sent without prior approval may not be accepted. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method, usually within 5 to 10 business days of the return being received and inspected.

Full terms are on the shipping and return policy page.

A continuous flow unit has no tank and no anode to replace, so care is mostly about keeping it clear and checking it still runs the way it should.

  • Keep the area around the unit clear so air can move freely and the flue is not obstructed.
  • Keep the filter at the cold water inlet clean, particularly if the supply carries sediment.
  • Have the gas and water connections checked by a licensed technician if you notice a change in temperature, flow or ignition.
  • Note any error code shown on the display before you call, because it points straight at the fault.
  • Book a service if the unit is cycling, taking longer to reach temperature or dropping temperature when a second tap opens.

If something is not right, our phone line is attended 24 hours on 1300 096 668.

How it works

From first call to hot water back on

The same four steps apply whether you are replacing a failed unit or planning an upgrade.

  1. Tell us what is happening

    Call or order online with your suburb and the system you have now. Photos of the unit and its data plate help a great deal.

  2. We scope and quote

    We confirm the model, the installation and any extras the site needs, then come back to you before anything is booked.

  3. We supply and install

    We bring the unit, disconnect the old system, install and commission the new one, and check the valves are working as they should.

  4. We clear the site

    The old unit is taken away where you have asked us to, the work is tested in front of you, and you get the paperwork and warranty details.

Rinnai B26 questions

The B26 suits most units, townhouses and smaller homes. Where a household runs several showers at once, or the kitchen and laundry are in use at the same time, a larger continuous flow unit may be the better choice. Tell us how many bathrooms you have and how the hot water gets used and we will confirm it before you order.

It is the same unit with a different pre-set delivery temperature. The 50° model is temperature limited for extra safety, which suits homes with young children. The 60° model delivers hotter water for the kitchen and laundry, and is normally paired with a tempering valve on the outlets that serve bathrooms.

No. This model is an external use only unit and mounts on an outside wall. If the only practical position is internal, we will look at a model built for that instead rather than fit this one somewhere it does not belong.

If you have your own plumber, order the unit by itself.

The valve kit is mandatory on instantaneous gas systems, so it applies to this unit. If you are not sure, order with what you know and we will confirm the final list with you before any work is booked.

.pdp-zoom svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:currentColor;flex:none}
.pdp-zoom:hover{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff}

.pdp-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.pdp-tags li{margin:0;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--navy);background:rgba(32,56,110,.08);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:7px 14px}

.pdp-facts{margin:4px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden}
.pdp-facts>div{margin:0;background:#fff;padding:13px 15px}
.pdp-facts dt{margin:0 0 3px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.pdp-facts dd{margin:0;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.35}

/* ---- enlarge ---- */
/* The toggle sits at the end of the document, so it is fixed rather than
   absolute: activating its label must not scroll the page to find it. */
.shws-state{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;clip-path:inset(50%)}
.pdp-lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:98;display:none;place-items:center;padding:clamp(14px,4vw,46px)}
#pdp-zoom:checked ~ .pdp-lightbox{display:grid}
html:has(#pdp-zoom:checked){overflow:hidden}
.pdp-lb-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(8,13,26,.87);cursor:zoom-out}
.pdp-lb-fig{position:relative;margin:0;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);
  width:min(720px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 44px 96px -34px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.pdp-lb-fig img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.pdp-lb-fig figcaption{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;
  font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink)}
.pdp-lb-x{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;
  display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy);
  transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease)}
.pdp-lb-x:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}

/* ---- intro column ---- */
.pdp-intro h1{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.9vw,2.5rem);margin-bottom:.42em;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.pdp-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 10px;margin:0 0 1.1em;padding:0;list-style:none}
.pdp-meta span{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--body);
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:6px 11px}
.pdp-meta strong{color:var(--ink)}
.pdp-meta span:last-child{color:#1d7a46;border-color:rgba(29,122,70,.28);background:rgba(29,122,70,.08)}
.pdp-intro .lede{margin-bottom:.9em}
.pdp-points{list-style:none;margin:0 0 clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);padding:0;display:grid;gap:9px 22px;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pdp-points li{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:21px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.5}
.pdp-points .ic{width:21px;height:21px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:2px}

.pdp-buybar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,2vw,28px);
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:clamp(18px,2.2vw,26px) clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px -28px rgba(13,20,38,.45)}
.pdp-price{flex:1 1 210px;min-width:0}
.pdp-price-k{margin:0 0 2px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.pdp-price-v{margin:0;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,2.8vw,2.3rem);
  line-height:1;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.pdp-price-n{margin:7px 0 0;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--body);line-height:1.5}
.pdp-cta{display:grid;gap:10px;flex:1 1 260px}
.pdp-cta .btn{width:100%}
.pdp-cta .btn-ghost{min-height:52px}

@media (max-width:1100px){.pdp-points{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .pdp-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}
  .pdp-gallery{max-width:520px;margin-inline:auto;width:100%}
  .pdp-points{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media (max-width:620px){.pdp-points{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pdp-facts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ---------- buy module ---------- */
.buy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,.75fr);gap:clamp(18px,2.2vw,28px);align-items:start}
.buy-main{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);
  box-shadow:var(--sh-1);display:grid;gap:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px)}
.buy-group{border:0;margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0}
.buy-k{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--navy);padding:0;margin-bottom:14px}
.opts{display:grid;gap:9px}
.opt{position:relative;display:block;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r);
  background:#fff;padding:15px 17px 15px 46px;transition:border-color var(--t) var(--ease),background-color var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease)}
.opt:hover{border-color:var(--navy-300);background:var(--paper-2)}
.opt input{position:absolute;left:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:19px;height:19px;margin:0;accent-color:var(--red);cursor:pointer}
.opt-body{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.opt-t{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.4}
.opt-t small{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:400;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--body);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5}
.opt-p{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;flex:none}
.opt:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-50);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--red) inset}
.opt:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px}
.opt.is-locked{cursor:default;background:var(--navy-50);border-color:var(--navy-300)}
.opt.is-locked:hover{background:var(--navy-50)}
.opt.is-locked input{cursor:default;opacity:.85}
.buy-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr;gap:11px;margin:13px 0 0;font-size:.87rem;color:var(--body);line-height:1.55}
.buy-note .ic{width:22px;height:22px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:2px}

.buy-side{background:var(--navy-50);border:1px solid #dbe3f1;border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);
  position:sticky;top:120px}
.buy-side-k{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 6px}
.buy-total{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.4vw,2.7rem);line-height:1;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 7px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.buy-side-sub{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--body);margin:0 0 18px}
.buy-sum{margin:0 0 18px;padding:16px 0 0;border-top:1px solid #dbe3f1;display:grid;gap:9px}
.buy-sum div{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}
.buy-sum dt{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--body);margin:0}
.buy-sum dd{margin:0;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink)}
.buy-sum-total{padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #dbe3f1}
.buy-sum-total dt{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-size:.98rem}
.buy-sum-total dd{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700}
.buy-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:stretch;margin-bottom:12px}
.buy-qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;flex:none}
.buy-qty button{width:40px;height:100%;min-height:54px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;
  font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.buy-qty button:hover{background:var(--navy-50)}
.buy-qty span{min-width:34px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink)}
.buy-add{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:54px}
.buy-added{margin:0 0 12px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;color:#1d7a46;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em}
.buy-added::before{content:"";width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#1d7a46;flex:none}
.buy-added[hidden]{display:none}
.buy-trust{list-style:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:14px 0 0;border-top:1px solid #dbe3f1;display:grid;gap:9px}
.buy-trust li{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--body)}
.buy-trust .ic{width:20px;height:20px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box}
.buy-hint{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 7px;line-height:1.55}
.buy-hint:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.linkish{border:0;background:none;padding:0;font:inherit;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.linkish:hover{color:var(--red-700)}
@media (max-width:1040px){.buy{grid-template-columns:1fr}.buy-side{position:static}}

/* ---------- why this unit: documentation style, not the home page cards ---------- */
.pdp-why{background:#fff}
.why-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.78fr) minmax(0,1.22fr);gap:clamp(28px,4vw,72px);align-items:start}
.why-head{position:sticky;top:132px}
.why-head h2{margin-bottom:.45em}
.why-kicker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr;gap:11px;align-items:start;margin:22px 0 0;
  padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem;color:var(--body);line-height:1.55}
.why-kicker .ic{width:24px;height:24px;padding:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:1px}

.why-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:clamp(22px,2.6vw,38px) clamp(24px,3vw,46px);counter-reset:why}
.why-list li{margin:0;padding-top:20px;border-top:3px solid var(--navy-50);position:relative}
.why-list li::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-3px;left:0;width:46px;height:3px;background:var(--red)}
.why-k{margin:0 0 9px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.15em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red-700)}
.why-list h3{margin:0 0 .45em;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.4vw,1.22rem);line-height:1.3}
.why-list p{margin:0;font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--body)}
@media (max-width:1040px){.why-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.why-head{position:static}}
@media (max-width:620px){.why-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.faq-a h4{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-size:1rem;margin:1.3em 0 .4em;color:var(--ink)}
.faq-a h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.faq-a ul{margin:0 0 1em;padding-left:1.15em}
.faq-a .tbl-wrap{box-shadow:none;color:var(--ink)}
.faq-a .tbl-wrap caption{color:var(--ink)}
.faq-a .tbl-wrap th{color:var(--ink)}
/* the value column reads as strongly as the label; the label keeps the weight */
.faq-a .tbl-wrap td{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}

/* ---------- related products ---------- */
.prodgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(16px,1.7vw,24px);list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.pcard{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);
  overflow:hidden;transition:border-color var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease)}
.pcard:hover{border-color:transparent;box-shadow:var(--sh-2);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.pcard-media{display:block;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7f9fc 0%,#e9eef6 100%);padding:16px;overflow:hidden}
.pcard-media img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;transition:transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease)}
.pcard:hover .pcard-media img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.pcard-body{padding:20px 20px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.pcard-cat{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--red-700);margin:0 0 7px}
.pcard h3{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.38;margin:0 0 9px}
.pcard h3 a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.pcard h3 a:hover{color:var(--red-700)}
.pcard-price{font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.22rem;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 15px}
.pcard .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%}
@media (max-width:1040px){.prodgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:520px){.prodgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* a table panel fills the accordion; prose keeps its reading measure */
.faq-a-wide{max-width:none}

/* ---------- product enquiry form ---------- */
.field-locked{margin-bottom:16px}
.field-locked input{background:var(--navy-50);border-color:#d4ddee;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;cursor:default}
.field-locked input:focus{outline:3px solid var(--navy-300);outline-offset:2px}
.field-note{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.form-card .field.full input::placeholder,.form-card textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
.linkish{border:0;background:none;padding:0;font:inherit;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
  text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.linkish:hover{color:var(--red-700)}
